import chess

def random_sequence(length):
    board = chess.Board()
    sequence = list()
    while len(sequence) < length:
        possible_moves = list(board.legal_moves)
        moves_to_play = [chess.Move.from_uci(move) for move in possible_moves]
        sequence.append(moves_to_play[0])
        board.push(moves_to_play[0])
    return sequence
